mainEntity.name: Does BigOrange currently offer home builder marketing consulting as a separate service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadership has not approved a distinct strategy-only consulting offer for this page. Publication is blocked until the audience, scope, deliverables, pricing approach, owner, and sales process are defined.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between consulting and managed marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consulting generally centers on diagnosis, decisions, plans, and review, while managed marketing includes approved implementation. BigOrange leadership must approve the exact distinction before this page can describe an offer.
The engagement must name the implementation owner for every recommendation. It may be the builder, an internal marketer, an approved vendor, or BigOrange under a separately defined scope.

mainEntity.name: Can marketing consulting guarantee rankings or leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. A responsible engagement can improve the controllable strategy, implementation plan, and measurement process, but it cannot guarantee rankings, leads, revenue, or placement in generated answers.

mainEntity.name: What should leadership approve before this page is published?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadership should approve the audience, problem, engagement model, deliverables, exclusions, implementation boundary, evidence, CTA, pricing approach, owner, and relationship to existing managed services.
